summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of the Prior Merger Agreement with Southern Energy Renewables Inc. after the Fairness Opinion Termination Rights expired upon receipt of required fairness opinions. The termination occurred automatically without liability. The company remains party to a separate Business Combination Agreement with XCF Global, Inc., which continues subject to customary closing conditions. No deal terms are specified. The filing does not indicate any board recommendation change or advisor assignments. Watch for updates on the XCF transaction or potential new proposals.
